title: Disabled Veterans Housing Support Act
official_summary:
Disabled Veterans Housing Support Act

This act excludes compensation received for a military service-connected disability from a veteran's income when determining eligibility for assistance under the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program.

The CDBG program provides grants to urban communities for development activities focused on revitalizing neighborhoods, economic development, and providing improved community facilities and services.

Additionally, the Government Accountability Office must report on how service-connected disability compensation is treated when determining eligibility for all programs administered by the Department of Housing and Urban Development. This includes identifying instances where the treatment of such compensation is inconsistent with the requirement under this act.

summary.headline: New law stops counting VA disability pay as income when deciding if veterans qualify for Community Development Block Grant help.
summary.what_it_does: When deciding whether a veteran qualifies for help paid for by Community Development Block Grants, the money they get for a service-connected disability will no longer count as income. These federal grants go to cities for things like fixing up neighborhoods, economic development, and community services. The law also requires the Government Accountability Office to report on how disability pay is counted across all Department of Housing and Urban Development programs. That report must point out where those programs handle it differently from this new rule.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans who receive service-connected disability compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their disability pay will not count as income when they apply for help funded by Community Development Block Grants, which may make it easier to qualify.

who_it_affects.group: Cities and local agencies that run Community Development Block Grant programs
who_it_affects.how: They must leave out veterans' service-connected disability pay when checking whether applicants are eligible.
It must study and report on how disability pay is treated in all HUD programs and flag any that conflict with this rule.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 20, 2026. The summary does not give a separate start date or a deadline for the GAO report.
